claim_text: The public Pierre Auger SD1500 vertical sample contains a first-harmonic right-ascension residual across the frozen energy-threshold family.

provenance.evidence: Official release archive and extracted CSV SHA-256 digests pinned.

preregistration.evidence: Population, five thresholds, statistic, seed, null and decision rule frozen before aggregate inspection.

ordinary_baseline.evidence: Uniform-RA null with observed event counts and threshold nesting.

synthetic_calibration.evidence: Uniform control returned zero and injected RA=0 direction was recovered.

response_model.evidence: RA scrambling preserves observed declination/energy acceptance structure for the scoped harmonic.

systematics.evidence: Dedicated sidereal-time, weather and exposure-stability attacks not yet executed.

multiple_testing.evidence: Five-threshold family corrected with global nested-null probability and Bonferroni check.

ordinary_alternatives.evidence: Known statistical variation and established cosmic-ray anisotropy context retained.

independent_dataset.evidence: Separate official IceCube track produced a compatible null under another instrument.

independent_replication.evidence: No independent team reproduction of this exact computation.

limitations: Public 10 percent sample and first harmonic in RA only.
